# Privacy policy — Just the Video for YouTube™

Last updated: November 6, 2026

Just the Video for YouTube™ does not collect, store or sell any personal data. It has no accounts, analytics or tracking.

What stays in your browser: your settings, the number of items removed on each tab (cleared when the tab closes), and your last playback speed.

What leaves your browser:
- Once a day, the extension downloads a public rules file from GitHub (github.com/GodHasJeanShorts/just-the-video-rules). The request carries no information about you beyond what any web request does.
- Only if you turn on "Show dislike counts": the ID of the YouTube video you are watching is sent to Return YouTube Dislike (returnyoutubedislike.com) to fetch its like and dislike counts. Their own privacy policy applies to that request. Turning the setting off stops these requests.

Nothing else is sent anywhere.

Questions: open an issue at github.com/GodHasJeanShorts/just-the-video-rules.
